summary:
**ARES (Autonomous Reconnaissance & Exploration System)** is an interactive Mars exploration and mission-planning platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 under the challenge "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map."

The project aims to support future Mars exploration by integrating NASA's planetary science data into an interactive platform. It enables users to explore Martian terrain, investigate geographical features, visualize elevation data, identify potential surface hazards, and plan exploration routes.

Its key feature, **Mission Commander Mode**, provides an educational simulation in which users manage a fictional Mars expedition by balancing resources such as power, water, oxygen, and mission time while completing exploration objectives.

By combining planetary mapping, scientific data visualization, route planning, and mission simulation, ARES transforms complex space exploration information into an accessible and engaging experience. The project aims to demonstrate how NASA's open scientific data can support better understanding of the Martian environment while inspiring students, researchers, and future space explorers.
